Smoldering Spire is a whitelisted Vanilla server created by a group of friends & veteran server administrators in search of a better gaming community. Server Features:

A unique, beautiful, and often deadly terrain.

Hidden chests throughout the world.

Owned and staffed by adults over the age of 20.

Rules:

Do not attack another player without their consent, this is not a PvP server.

Unlocked chests and homes can be seized by other players. This rule is not intended to promote stealing, but we feel the risk of loss adds some excitement to the game.

All players spawn with the ability to lock chests and protect land.

No bigotry (racism, sexism, homophobia, etc) or hostile personal attacks. Don't be a douchebag, keep leet speak to a minimum, and try to behave as an adult.

Do not openly accuse another player of hacking, cheating, stealing, etc. If you have an issue with a player, submit a petition or speak privately with a moderator.

Abusing or misusing a bug is prohibited.

If it is not listed in the rules, use common sense or ask a moderator!

Keep the world looking nice. If you can see the spawn city, you’re too close. Please build farther away from spawn.
